::: {.section-intro}
leaflet.indoor adds indoor layers and an accessible floor selector to R Leaflet maps. Each dataset displays one floor at a time, with independent controls when several maps are present.
:::

GitHub version: 0.1.0.9000. Experimental package, not distributed on CRAN.

::: {.link-list}
[GitHub](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/leaflet-indoor){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[Documentation](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/leaflet-indoor/){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
:::

## Features

- Display `sf`, GeoJSON and optional `SpatVector` data.
- Navigate between floors and integrate maps with Shiny.
- Attach photo carousels and captions to rooms.
- Work with geographic coordinates or local Cartesian plans.

## Example and getting started

The [getting started guide](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/leaflet-indoor/articles/get-started.html) demonstrates synthetic data, styles and coordinate systems. The example data do not describe a real building.

The interface remains experimental: consult the documentation for the version used before integrating the package into an application.

Public sources checked on September 23, 2026.
